$comment: The one GitHub App each org runs for pack sync and the launcher. `org/apply.mjs create-app` fills `$`-placeholders from the overlay and prints GitHub's URL-parameter registration link. No webhook: the launcher polls. Permissions, each needed by a caller: actions write (launcher dispatches sync and reads its runs), checks read (verify and promote read head checks), statuses write (verdict-recheck posts codex-verdict; promote reads head statuses), contents write (branches, pack commits, evidence images, refs), issues write (claims, labels, compliance issue), pull_requests write (open, update, auto-merge, merge), workflows write (the pack ships std-gate.yml), metadata read (always).
name: $app_name
description: Standards sync, credential expiry sentinel and agent launcher for $org.
